entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7357"/><title type="x-s2">CHAPTER 9</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Prov.9.1-Prov.9.18">Pr 9:1-18</reference>. The commendation of wisdom is continued, under the figure of a liberal host, and its provisions under that of a feast (compare <reference osisRef="Luke.14.16-Luke.14.24">Lu 14:16-24</reference>).
